_meta.notes: The app ships from a branch and a student's browser caches it, so a class can be sitting on three different builds without anyone knowing. The version is baked in here and compared against what the device last saw. On a change, one sheet, once, listing what moved in the student's own words. Bump `version` and put the newest block first in `releases`. Entries are for the person using it: what is different on their screen, never what changed in the code.

releases.head: What is new
changes: Journey stays where you left it. Tapping a choice no longer throws you back to the top of the page.
You can say what else you do besides lessons. A CCA, training, leadership, looking after people at home, a job. It tells you what that is building and where it can go.
Your week counts in Journey now. It pays into every school year on its own, without a turn spent on it.
At Sec 1 and Sec 2 your subjects are no longer counted as a load. They are compulsory, so that was never your decision to be measured on.
The Aa button says Words, because that is what it opens.

releases.head: What is new
changes: You can undo a year now. Change your mind on the screen right after you live it.
Before you start, three lines on how a turn works.
You can play the short game: just the school years, to 18. It fits one lesson.
Aim remembers what you said you would do, and asks you about it next time.

releases.head: What is new
changes: Your year is decided as a whole now. Pick what you do, pick who you ask, then tap Live this year once.
People you can ask sit beside the year. Asking is free and does not spend your points.
Points change with your real load. A fuller year gives you fewer, and the line under them says why.
Aim knows what you already played and what your subjects reach right now.
A class code, so your whole class can see what it holds between everyone.
The turn screen no longer slides sideways on a phone.
